facts.fact: The BCRG's supervision director general said the central bank is operationalising NimbaPay, a national instant payment platform interoperating banks, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions.

GIN.note: No licensing or regional link stated.
No consumer-protection rule or redress body stated.
Salary digitalisation tools are an Orange offer, with no government programme stated.
The 70% cash figure is a share of payments at equipped merchants, not a survey share of adults with an account.

facts.fact: Orange Finance Mobile Guinee offers mobile money merchant payment, including Orange Money Pro, Djoula and bulk payments, as presented at a 23 July 2026 meeting in Conakry.
The BCRG's supervision director general cited NimbaPay as a platform ensuring interoperability between banks, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions.

GIN.note: Fiscal incentives for digital payment are only being studied.
